description: Prepare monthly pay apps from the schedule of values and invoices for small jobs; submit them by email or through the federal invoicing portal; confirm and apply payments
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $15,000 billed in a typical month; a misdirected payment is usually unrecoverable (for FC-1, FAR 52.232-33(e)(2) puts the loss on the company if its EFT information was wrong); clients pay on monthly cycles so a few days' delay is tolerable
manual_workaround: Prepare the pay app from the last saved PDF and the schedule of values spreadsheet; hand-deliver or upload from the phone; confirm remittance details by phone at the number in the contract
dependent_third_parties: Project management SaaS vendor; email provider; clients; VA paying office; bank
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure); home office

description: Check subcontractor invoices against the pay app; collect lien waivers; pay by ACH from the bank portal or by check
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: About $9,000 paid out in a typical month; FC-1 subcontractors must be paid within 7 days of receipt of the Government's payment with an interest penalty if late (FAR 52.232-27(c)); unpaid subcontractors stop work and can file liens on private jobs
manual_workaround: Write checks from the paper checkbook; confirm any bank detail by calling the subcontractor at the number in the signed subcontract
dependent_third_parties: Bank; accounting SaaS vendor; subcontractors and suppliers
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only signer on the bank account)

description: Drawings, RFIs, submittals, change orders, daily logs, inspections, and weekly certified payroll submission for FC-1
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Subcontractor crews build from current drawings; working from superseded sheets causes rework and safety issues; FAR 52.222-8(b)(1) requires weekly certified payrolls on FC-1; RPO set by the SaaS vendor's backups
manual_workaround: Printed current plan sets in the truck; RFIs and daily notes by phone and paper, entered after recovery; certified payrolls on the optional paper form
dependent_third_parties: Project management SaaS vendor; architects; subcontractors; inspectors
dependent_people_or_facilities: Owner (single point of failure; only superintendent); jobsites

description: Takeoffs, pricing, subcontractor quotes, and proposals, including federal and DoD subcontract bids
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Bid due times are fixed and late bids are rejected; MTD applies in bid weeks (otherwise 72 hours); RPO of 24 hours is not supported today because estimate files on the laptop have no backup
manual_workaround: Rebuild the estimate from subcontractor quotes in email and the takeoff in the AI assistant; submit from any device
dependent_third_parties: Email provider; AI bid assistant vendor (optional)

description: SAM registration and representations, SPRS (planned), insurance, license renewals, taxes, 1099s, and bookkeeping
mtd_rto_rpo_drivers: Deadlines are measured in weeks; SAM banking information must stay correct to protect federal payments (P01 R-003)
manual_workaround: Use the government and vendor portals directly from the phone; paper copies of key contracts and the SAM record in the home office
dependent_third_parties: Outside bookkeeper; tax preparer; insurance agent
